name: Character
description: Characters represents Actors which can be possessed, can move and interact with world. They are the default Skeletal Mesh Character built for nanos world.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: World location to spawn at

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: World rotation to spawn with

parameters.name: skeletal_mesh_asset
parameters.description: The Skeletal Mesh asset to use

parameters.name: collision_type
parameters.description: Collision profile of this Actor

parameters.name: gravity_enabled
parameters.description: Whether gravity affects this Actor

parameters.name: max_health
parameters.description: Current / Max Health

parameters.name: death_sound
parameters.description: Played when Character dies

parameters.name: pain_sound
parameters.description: Played when Character takes damage

parameters.name: spawn_mode
parameters.description: Pass SpawnMode.AfterConstructor or SpawnMode.Manual to avoid immediately sending the entity to clients and improve performance when you want to configure it by setting several configs. Must call FinishSpawn() after all

parameters.name: walking
parameters.description: Max acceleration while walking

parameters.name: parachuting
parameters.description: Max acceleration while parachuting

parameters.name: skydiving
parameters.description: Max acceleration while skydiving

parameters.name: falling
parameters.description: Max air control acceleration while falling

parameters.name: swimming
parameters.description: Max acceleration while swimming underwater

parameters.name: swimming_surface
parameters.description: Max acceleration while swimming on the surface

parameters.name: flying
parameters.description: Max acceleration while flying

functions.name: SetAirControl
functions.description: Sets the amount of movement control allowed when it is in air

parameters.name: air_control
parameters.description: When falling, amount of lateral movement control available to the character. 0 = no control, 1 = full control at max speed of MaxWalkSpeed

parameters.name: boost_multiplier
parameters.description: When falling, multiplier applied to air_control when lateral velocity is less than boost_velocity_threshold. Setting this to zero will disable air control boosting. Final result is clamped at 1

parameters.name: boost_velocity_threshold
parameters.description: When falling, if lateral velocity magnitude is less than this value, air_control is multiplied by boost_multiplier. Setting this to zero will disable air control boosting

functions.name: SetCameraMode
functions.description: Sets the Camera Mode
functions.description_long:
Sets the Camera Mode (i.e. Only TPS, FPS or if allow both)

Using FPSOnly CameraMode on AI will lock his body rotation (when using LookAt)

parameters.name: camera_mode
parameters.description: The new Camera Mode

functions.name: SetHighFallingTime
functions.description: Sets time to transition to HighFalling state
functions.description_long:
Sets time elapsed until automatically transition to HighFalling state (from SmallFalling) in seconds

Set it to -1 to never enter HighFalling time and consequently do not ragdoll when falling

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Default is 1 second
